characterization.observed_assertion: A retained exact approved envelope completes once after the kernel is reopened on the same SQLite database.
The restarted vault reports neither parent nor child identity live, yet the child lease still verifies through the hydrated public session registry.
A root lease verifies and is not revoked after restart.

required_behavior: Private-key loss ends the session authority. Revoke roots and descendants before admission; retain public identities, signatures, audit, spent nonces and budget history as evidence only. Fresh sessions and grants require fresh authority.
scope: Real authority kernel and SQLite exercised by inherited tests; pipeline execution uses a mock sandbox. No production action or Firecracker effect claimed.
next_verification: Replace authorization-survival expectations with exact-envelope denial and zero dispatch after restart
Revoke descendant and orphaned-delegation leases atomically with session invalidation
Preserve nonce consumption, reservations and settled usage; unknown usage must not become a refund
Fail closed on crash, audit outage or overlapping authority owners during boot recovery
